lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\kicad_viewer\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
7 uses of the private API of the server in 4 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/Listener/AddCspEventListener.php:24 OCP\AppFramework\Http\EmptyContentSecurityPolicy::allowEvalScript(): deprecated since Nextcloud 17, Nextcloud 33 is the last major to have it; Eval should not be used anymore. Please update your scripts. This function will stop functioning in a future version of Nextcloud.
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated and that Nextcloud 36 no longer has: the app fails on the first major without it, once it declares that one.

Nothing in the app calls 3 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 9 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
lib/ reads the clock directly in 2 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
